items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: he was playing with a band, they called himself, the Young Olympia band. And that was with Siren Moreira

ctx.x: What bands did you hear Sidney work with? I mean, who was he playing with at this time, Sidney Bechet?

At the time before Sidney left, he was playing with a band, they called himself, the Young Olympia band. And that was with Siren Moreira, and Buddy P.T. Sometimes Buddy would send Louis Armstrong into his place, and John Marrero. They had a wonderful band. Yeah.

Did the, I mean music, when you were coming out, was it the same sort of thing as now? I mean the trumpet would just play a couple of choruses in the lead, and then they'd take solos? No, no, they didn't do that.
